content.title: CAU News | Campus Life
content.text: Chung-Ang University’s College of Physical Education has been actively advancing global engagement initiatives by establishing and strengthening partnerships with overseas universities from last year through the present. As part of these efforts, on Monday, Dec. 8, 2025, the College of Physical Education (Dean Jae-woo Kim) signed a comprehensive cooperation agreement with the School of Education at Gonzaga University (Dean Yolanda Gallardo; Program director Andrew Kim). Founded in 1887, Gonzaga University is a private Catholic Jesuit institution located in Spokane, Washington, U.S. According to the 2023 U.S. News & World Report U.S. university rankings, Gonzaga was tied for 83rd. The university is known not only for education but also for its celebrated basketball team, the “Gonzaga Bulldogs,” and for operating a wide range of sports teams. Under the agreement, the two institutions discussed cooperation in areas including international joint research and academic exchange, co-teaching and joint seminars, and exchange activities between athletic teams. Following the signing ceremony, Dean Jae-woo Kim stated, “Starting with focused, attainable initiatives, we intend to build toward a more comprehensive and wide-ranging partnership.” Andrew Kim, a Chung-Ang University alumnus (Class of 2006) who attended the ceremony on behalf of the Gonzaga School of Education dean, remarked, “Being back at my alma mater for this ceremony is truly meaningful. I will convey CAU’s intentions to Gonzaga’s dean and senior administrators and actively support the realization of this exchange.”
